veranderings.voor: Sy mense het hom as heilig beskou en as afgesonderd van ander.
veranderings.na: Sy mense het hom as heilig en afgesonderd van ander beskou.
veranderings.rede: The second complement trails after the final verb; both belong before 'beskou' in a single verb-final clause.

veranderings.voor: Sy woord het ook gegeld op plekke
veranderings.na: Die koning se woord het ook gegeld op plekke
veranderings.rede: Directly after a general sentence about 'n Leier, 'Sy' could refer to any such leader; the past tense shows the king is meant, so name him.

veranderings.blok: Klipmure by die koning se woonplek
veranderings.rede: The compound preposition is written 'bo-op' (hyphen at the vowel clash).
The compound preposition is written 'bo-op' (hyphen at the vowel clash).

veranderings.na: hoe mag by hulle gewerk het
veranderings.rede: 'hulle mag gewerk het' reads first as the modal 'they may have worked'; moving the noun 'mag' to subject position removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: waar mense glo hul leier staan tussen hulle en hul voorouers en vir hulle reën kan vra
veranderings.na: waar mense glo dat hul leier tussen hulle en hul voorouers staan en vir hulle reën kan vra
veranderings.rede: A definition should use the full 'glo dat' clause with the verb at the end rather than the spoken form without 'dat'.

veranderings.voor: Sy mag kom uit daardie geloof
veranderings.na: Die leier se mag kom uit daardie geloof
veranderings.rede: 'Sy mag kom' reads as 'she may come'; naming the leader makes 'mag' clearly the noun and fixes the unclear pronoun.

veranderings.voor: aflei wat gebeur het, oor nou of oor lank gelede
veranderings.na: aflei wat onlangs of lank gelede gebeur het
veranderings.rede: 'oor nou of oor lank gelede' is unidiomatic; the time span belongs inside the clause, with 'onlangs' matching 'het gebeur'. If this is a shared definition, the reviewer should send it on rather than apply it.

vlae.rede: The block heading has the same 'bo op' spelling as the two body sentences. If 'bo-op' is accepted there, the heading should match, but a script cannot change a heading.

vlae.teks: Hy het nie self elke nedersetting regeer nie, maar deur leiers onder hom. Onder hom was daar groter en kleiner leiers, elkeen met sy eie deel.
vlae.rede: 'onder hom' comes twice in a row and reads repetitively. I left it because these sentences are part of the protected chain of four leading up to the definition of 'staat'.
